topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out my friend's been fibbing about their job. It’s a tough pill to swallow, but I know people have their reasons. I’m not going to turn my back or jump to judgments. Instead, I want to talk it through, see where they’re coming from. Maybe they’re under some pressure or maybe they just needed a moment to breathe. Whatever it is, I’m here to listen, to support them in finding a way forward. It’s a chance to understand each other a bit better, to help mend and strengthen our friendship. We all stumble at times, but it’s how we stand back up that truly counts.
